Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Jagmohan Bansal

Present: Mr. Onkar Singh Batalvi, Advocate
 for the petitioner
 Mr. Amit Sharma, Advocate
 for Union of India
 Mr. Deepanjay Sharma D.A.G, Punjab
 ****
Jagmohan Bansal, J. (Oral)
1.

The petitioner through instant petition under Articles 226/227 of Constitution of India is seeking
direction to respondents No. 1 and 2 to re-issue/renew his passport.
2.  The petitioner vide application dated 29.09.2021 applied for re-issue/renewal of his passport.

The respondents have not re-issued/renewed passport on the ground that an FIR No. 19 dated 27.01.2012, under Sections 420, 465, 467, 468 and 471 of IPC and Section 31 of Representation of People Act, 1950 is pending against him.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that police after completing investigation has filed challan, however, charges have not been framed and petitioner has filed CRM-M-27805 of 2017 before this Court seeking quashing of aforesaid FIR.

This Court vide 1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2023:PHHC:107199 CWP-29255 of 2022 -2- 2023:PHHC:107199 order dated 03.08.2017 directed the respondents therein not to take coercive steps against the petitioner.
On account of said order, the trial court, though challan was presented in 2017, has not framed charges.

The case of the petitioner is squarely covered by Office Memorandum dated 04.03.2023, thus, respondents may be Joginder Singh Bhambra vs Union Of India And Ors on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69589374/
1 directed to to consider case of the petitioner and decide in the light of aforesaid Office Memorandum.
4.

sentences.text: Learned State counsel does not dispute the aforesaid factual position.

5. Learned counsel for Union of India submits that competent authority would look into grievance of the petitioner and pass an appropriate order, within six months from today, considering the aforesaid Office Memorandum as well Notification No. 570 dated 25.08.1993.
6.
In the wake of statement of learned counsel for Union of India, the petition stands disposed of.
